# hg env

**What this page tells you:** every `hg env` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The environment spec → generated pulumi stack config.

## Synopsis

```text
hg env new [flags]
hg env plan [flags]
hg env apply [flags]
hg env import [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

One environment.yaml (infra/environments/<name>.yaml, schema cli/schemas/environment/v1alpha1) is the source of truth for BOTH Pulumi stacks; the Pulumi.<name>.yaml files are generated projections with a do-not-edit banner. Secret values never live in the spec - {secret: true} leaves mark values that exist only as pulumi-encrypted ciphertext in the generated file, carried through regeneration untouched.

## `hg env new`

```text
hg env new [flags]
```

Day-0 from the root-of-trust coordinates: stacks init'd, config generated, pulumi up, hand-off (#676).

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--spec` | `<file>` | — | Spec path override (default infra/environments/<name>.yaml). |
| `--dry-run` | — | — | Print the exact command sequence (env prefixes included, hand-executable); apply nothing. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg env new scratch --dry-run
hg env new scratch
```

## `hg env plan`

```text
hg env plan [flags]
```

Diff the spec against the generated stack config - exit 1 on drift (the doctor finding).

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--spec` | `<file>` | — | Spec path override (default infra/environments/<name>.yaml). |

**Examples**

```bash
hg env plan factory
```

## `hg env apply`

```text
hg env apply [flags]
```

Regenerate both stack config files from the spec.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--spec` | `<file>` | — | Spec path override. |

## `hg env import`

```text
hg env import [flags]
```

One-shot: existing hand-written stack config -> environment.yaml (the migration path).

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--state` | `<file>` | — | State stack config (default state/Pulumi.<name>.yaml). |
| `--infra` | `<file>` | — | Infra stack config (default infra/Pulumi.<name>.yaml). |
| `--out` | `<file>` | — | Where to write the spec (default infra/environments/<name>.yaml). |

**Examples**

```bash
hg env import factory
```
